messages:
tessa_cs: FYI Renewal for Verdant Labs is tight. They submitted a PO request but also offered CC as backup. PO needs vendor code; CC needs payment auth + cardholder verification. Goal: close before month-end. Doc: https://docsend.com/view/verdant-renewal-v4

devin_se: they asked to shorten term to 9 months and include one enablement workshop. Care about streaming tokens. Will this affect Dedicated sizing?

aleena_ae: usage spike last week but only at 40% of reserved concurrency. Retention looks ok if training happens. Recommend booking enablement in same month as renewal to reduce churn risk.

kyle_proc: for PO route we need W9 + remit address + legal entity exact name. Vendor-code turnaround is ~48h after docs. If CC, fraud review takes ~24h for >$25k. Which path are they leaning?

tessa_cs: Customer replied: they prefer PO; will send W9 but asked if we can invoice monthly instead of upfront. Also asked for a 9-month term with pro-rated termination.

harper_legal: 9-month term ok with a 10% uplift on list. We need explicit no-auto-renew clause and a prorate formula: "Prorated refund equals (unused full months / total term months) * prepaid fees" if prepaid. I'll draft amendment language.

pricing-team: Confirm uplift: 10% for 9-month. If they pay monthly, uplift can be 8% because we lose prepay. Training add-on billed as separate line item monthly. Need final headcount and expected token volume to size infra.

aleena_ae: i'll request seat count and token estimate from CS. Also will schedule enablement hold for two 2hr sessions wk of 3/22.

kyle_proc: once W9 arrives send to procurement@redwood.com. We'll fast-track vendor code only if remit address matches W9. Otherwise fallback to CC.

tessa_cs: i've uploaded SOW_rev4 and sent W9 link. Created DocuSign envelope for amendment with 9-month term. esign-bot will post when signer signs.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created for Verdant Labs Renewal Amendment (SOW_rev4). Status: awaiting signer (sara@verdantlabs.com).

harper_legal: drafted clause attached in DocSend. No other legal blockers.

tessa_cs: TL;DR: Verdant prefers PO; W9 incoming; pricing uplift agreed (10% or 8% if monthly); enablement scheduled pending signature. Target: close by month-end. :white_check_mark:
